tasks.title: Win model: constrain P(win) to be non-decreasing in discount so guidance never says a smaller discount wins more
acceptance: pricing/model.py trains LightGBM with monotone_constraints=+1 on discount_pct (0 on all other features) and monotone_constraints_method=advanced
for every deal in data/synthetic/deals.csv the /recommend curve is non-decreasing in discount; a test asserts this on a 300-deal sample
zero recommendations on the sample lower the discount while raising win_prob_at_rec above win_prob_at_current by more than 2 points; a test asserts this

holdout AUC stays within 0.03 of the unconstrained model on the sample (baseline 0.640; measured 0.619 with the constraint on 2026-09-11) and the model docstring states the constraint and why: discount is endogenous, high discounts mark deals already in trouble, so an unconstrained tree reads the marker as the cause

tests/test_model.py and tests/test_defended_vs_investigate.py pass; the /sample figures the landing page quotes (67.1M, 11.2M, 81.4%, 60.8%) are unchanged because the diagnostic does not use the model

review.notes: All 8 criteria verified by execution: constraint derived from X.columns, advanced method, 0/2000 declining curves, AUC 0.6186 within band, fixtures clean, no scope drift, no em dashes, landing figures unchanged. Nits: AUC floor 0.60 should be 0.61 to encode the 0.03 band; leakage_vs_model shifts 7.06M->7.74M (10.5%->11.5%) and feature importance reorders, add to PR body; idxmin used positionally at test_model.py:194; 151/300 cited vs 149 reproduced; ADR needed in DECISIONS.md (lead)
